name: Mathiel's Armor
summary: At the forge in Darnassus, Mathiel's Armor brings night elf and dwarven craft together. Mathiel works in the Warrior's Terrace, using methods devised by Furen Longbeard to shape exotic materials into armor for Alliance warriors.

sections.title: A Blend of Crafts
sections.body: Night elf armorers have favored methods honed over millennia, with work shaped by nature, supple leathers, and carefully worked metals. Trade with the Eastern Kingdoms has led smiths such as Mathiel to try new ways. He brings the dwarven techniques devised by Furen Longbeard together with elven craft.

sections.title: Exotic Components
sections.body: Mathiel needs sunscorched eggshells from the Highperch wyvern nests in Thousand Needles. He renders the sun-hardened shells into lacquer and uses Furen's heat-treatment formulas to forge resilient leggings for the front lines.

faq.answer: Mathiel is a skilled night elf armorsmith in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. He works with fellow Alliance craftsmen and tests ideas from allies such as Furen Longbeard.

Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorsmith who lives in Stormwind City. He devised methods for tempering and forging specialized armor plates, and shares instructions and designs with allied smiths.

faq.q: What materials were used to forge the armor?
aliases: what is mathiel's armor made of
faq.answer: The armor uses sunscorched eggshells gathered below the Highperch wyvern nests in Thousand Needles. Mathiel reinforces and shapes them with Furen Longbeard's smithing methods.

faq.q: Why is an elf using dwarven techniques?
faq.answer: Alliance smiths share knowledge to equip their fighters against growing threats. Mathiel uses dwarven hardening methods alongside the finesse and durability of night elf smithing.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The work begins and ends at the forge in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, on the island of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the previous quest in this chain?
faq.answer: The chain follows 'Sunscorched Shells', in which an adventurer travels to a distant part of Kalimdor to gather tough eggshells for Mathiel's craft.

angles.text: For Alliance warriors, this chain yields sturdy leggings made with night elf and dwarven smithing knowledge.
Dwarven tempering and night elf forge craft come together in this work.
Mathiel and Furen's partnership shows how the Alliance unites distant peoples through trade and mutual defense to serve its military needs.
